summary: Upstage's official Solar Pro 2 guide says new Console signups automatically receive $10 in free credits, usable for all Upstage APIs. A default API key is generated upon signup. Neither an enrollment deadline nor a three-month credit-validity period is stated on the loaded official pages. Whether the free grant requires a card is unknown; the pricing page's card information concerns paid credit purchases and is not evidence of free-grant eligibility. Paid credit usage can continue with charges to a registered payment method after credits run out. This grant is distinct from institutional free access and Studio agent free runs.
claim_steps: Create an Upstage Console account using the Log in control; the official guide says $10 in free credits is granted automatically.
On the Getting Started page, copy the default API key generated upon signup to test the APIs.

social_proof.title: Solar Pro 2 Introduces – “Call the Upstage Console API in Just 1 Minute”
social_proof.text: Visit the Upstage Console and sign up to receive **$10 in free credits** automatically. With these credits, you can test all Upstage APIs, including me!
